application_type_full: Prior Approval: Development for electronic communications network
description: Prior Approval notification for the installation of a 17.5m monopole with six antennas, two equipment cabinets, two transmission dishes and ancillary development including three remote radio units (RRU's).
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The prior approval notification received 06/08/2026 is acknowledged. The proposed development has been assessed against Condition A.2(1)(b), A.2(1)(c), A.2(1)(d) and A.3(4) of Schedule 2 Part 16 of the General Permitted Development Order as it requires prior approval and because of its sitting and appearance, would result in a visually intrusive structure, creating a visually cluttered environment that would have a detrimental impact upon the character of the Chiswick House Conservation Area, causing harm to the trees nearby and the road safety of Great West Road. Thus, on the basis of the submitted information, TCP/5456/Y/100, ARB/5456/Y/200, CS 20746020 Site Specific Supplementary Information, CS 20746020 ICNIRP Declaration with Clarification Letter, CS 20746020 Pre Consultation Letter, CS 20746020 GPSO Application Letter, CS 20746020 Coverage Plots, CS 20746020 Arboriculturist Response to TFL comments, 100 Rev A, 200 Rev B, 201 Rev C, 300 Rev C, 301 Rev D, CS 20746020 Permitted Development Notice, CS 20746020 Tree Survey Report Version 2, Photomontage Pack, 5G Services Sheet, Health Summary Sheet, General Background Information for Telecommunications Development, EMF Guidelines, Coverage and Capacity Sheet, How it Works Sheet, Planning for Telecommunications Sheet submitted 6th August 2026. Supplementary Information Sheet, MP Letter Supporting digital infrastructure deployment in your local area, Clarification of ICNIRP Clarification Letter, Received 10/08/2026.  23/82258/TEL56 Appeal Decision, 22/01485/TELE Appeal Decision, received 21.08/2026 would be detrimental to the Chiswick House Conservation Area, contrary to the NPPF, London Plan Policies D8, T2, T4 and T7 and Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2, CC4 and EC4.
